purpose: exact fully crossed finite live domain; supersedes the earlier separate seat and uniform-transport live projection

supersedes_live_projection.disposition: named early projection only; not this domain and not an all-configurations claim

claim_boundary.allowed_claim: exhaustive only over this literal finite domain and its recorded digest

catalog_rule.identity: raw model id; normalization is exclusion-only

case_identity.seat_order: critic, defender, judge:0, judge:1, optional judge:2, optional variator
case_identity.set_digest_algorithm: SHA-256 over UTF-8-bytewise-sorted case ids, each prefixed by its unsigned 8-byte big-endian byte length
case_identity.completeness_oracle: independent literal Cartesian generator; cardinality, uniqueness, and case-id set digest must match before dispatch

request_integrity.reasoning_field: required in every final body; string settings preserve their value and integer 2000 maps through the shipped adapter to wire string low while remaining a distinct typed case-id input
request_integrity.kimi_check: repeat exclusion normalization on every final body's exact model field

concurrency.mechanism: one shared threading.BoundedSemaphore(3) around every endpoint complete call, including retries, repairs, split legs, and private endpoints

registered_terminal_outcomes.configuration_refused: shipped compile/runtime refusal before provider-dependent prose could decide the case
registered_terminal_outcomes.trial_outcome: semantic result from the shipped defended court
registered_terminal_outcomes.provider_indeterminate: provider-dependent transport, availability, envelope, parse, timeout, silence, or related boundary
registered_terminal_outcomes.unexpected_error: unregistered driver failure; preserve first boundary and block PASS

registered_nonterminal_states.integrity_stop: global invariant failure; freeze prior records and stop provider contact
registered_nonterminal_states.interrupted: attempt ended with registered cases still unterminated
registered_nonterminal_states.pending: no immutable terminal record exists for this case id

evidence_rules.first_typed_boundary: preserve stage, exception type, typed code, pointer, exact message, and dispatch extent verbatim when present
evidence_rules.raw_prose: stored separately from parser, schema, and fallback receipts
evidence_rules.hidden_reasoning_trace: never store text; record key presence, byte count, and digest only
evidence_rules.resource_exhaustion: report exact completed-id set and exact pending remainder; never claim exhaustiveness

research_disposition.adopt: finite scope, isolation, typed outcomes, reproducible traces
research_disposition.reject: coverage-guided BFS, random insertion, abstraction or duplicate reduction, contract exclusions

research_disposition.adopt: separate bounds, canonical ids, completeness relative only to bounds
research_disposition.reject: SMT pruning, symmetry or subsumption reduction, heuristic queue, satisfying-only output

research_disposition.adopt: frozen inventory, exact ordered pair enumeration, per-option receipts
exact seat orders and separate receipts
separate raw prose, parser, and fallback receipts
research_disposition.reject: accuracy ranking and learned evaluator preference

research_disposition.adopt: both judge orders and raw outputs
research_disposition.reject: degraded-gold labels, composite scores, score-driven routing

research_disposition.adopt: negative precedent that pairwise minima and heuristic profiles are not a full product, and post-hoc constraint fixes are unsafe
research_disposition.reject: pairwise substitution, constrained reduction, optimal subsets

research_disposition.adopt: tiny exact Cartesian mutation oracle and cardinality equality
research_disposition.reject: random domains, trial counts, shrinking as campaign evidence
